rule: Dose selection remains syndrome-specific. Volume is generated only when source_concentration_per_ml is explicitly present.

entries.repeat: every 5 min if ABC compromise persists
entries.source: ERC 2025 anaphylaxis: 0.01 mg/kg = 10 micrograms/kg, max 0.5 mg, using adrenaline 1 mg/mL

entries.indication: general pediatric hypoglycemia when IV treatment is required
entries.repeat: recheck glucose after 5-10 min and repeat as needed
entries.source: ERC/RCUK 2025 PLS: 0.2 g/kg = 2 mL/kg of 10% glucose

entries.indication: cardiac arrest caused by severe hyperkalemia
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: insulin 0.1 unit/kg, max 10 units, with glucose

entries.indication: cardiac arrest caused by severe hyperkalemia
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: 10% glucose 5 mL/kg, max 250 mL, with insulin

entries.indication: severe hypokalemia <2.5 mmol/L with life-threatening symptoms or cardiac arrest
entries.administration: 2 mmol/min for first 10 min, then remainder if required over 5-10 min

entries.indication: concurrent hypomagnesemia in severe hypokalemia / selected arrhythmia context
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: consider magnesium sulfate 30-50 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: severe acute asthma in children >=2 y after inadequate response to initial therapy
entries.source: GINA 2026: 40-50 mg/kg IV, max 2 g over 20-60 min

entries.repeat: up to 3 doses, 20-30 min apart with SABA
entries.source: GINA 2026: 250 micrograms nebulized or 4 puffs of 20 micrograms
Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: ketamine 1-2 mg/kg IV
Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: rocuronium 1-2 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: pediatric emergency intubation neuromuscular blockade when not contraindicated
entries.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: succinylcholine 1-2 mg/kg IV
